get_user_prompt_cot_bright: generate a chain-of-thought user prompt from a query string for the Bright model
fill_sys_prompt: fill the num_questions placeholder in a system prompt template with the desired count
fill_user_prompt: wrap a document in XML tags to create a user prompt for question generation
prompt_registry: look up a prompt template by key such as baseline, hq_gen, or cot_bright
DOC2HARD_QUERY: use the hard query prompt template to generate reasoning-intensive domain-aligned questions from a document
